subject: Request: consumption rebate after scheduled maintenance impact
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@veridian.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:22:00Z
Subject: Impact during 9/29 scheduled maintenance — rebate request

Jonas / Marissa,

Quick note from our ops and finance teams — during the scheduled maintenance window on 2026-09-29 we saw elevated tail latency and several streaming ingestion timeouts that impacted two of our downstream jobs. Our engineers estimate ~18 hours of degraded throughput across the environment; that spike pushed us over our monthly processing envelope and materially increased costs for the month.

We appreciate the proactive communication about the maintenance, but given the operational and billing impact Veridian is requesting a consumption rebate for the October invoice while we finish the postmortem. Specifically, our CFO asked if Redwood can provide a concession (rebate or credit) tied to the overage caused by the degradation.

Can you confirm what concessions you can offer and the approval path? We need a short note for our accounting team to justify the adjustment.

Attachments: veridian_usage_oct.csv (summarized token counts)

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Operations
Veridian Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Impact during 9/29 scheduled maintenance — rebate request

Team — forwarding Veridian's note (below). They have a legitimate billing impact related to our maintenance window. Drafting an offer: propose a consumption rebate equal to 10% of October's invoice for the account (capped at $25k) plus one month of service credit (applied as a billing credit) as a goodwill gesture, contingent on delivery of the RCA and confirmation of the usage overage.

Points I want exec sign-off on before replying to Elena:
- Approve rebate structure: 10% up to $25k + one free month credit
- Condition: RCA delivered within 10 business days; corrective timeline and mitigation commitments documented
- Accounting treatment: issue a credit note and apply to next invoice (HubSpot record HS-298427)

I've attached Veridian's usage summary they sent. If you want different numbers (15% / $30k) call it out now — otherwise I recommend we agree to the above to resolve quickly.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachments: veridian_usage_oct.csv

On 2026-10-01 Elena Ruiz wrote:
> Jonas / Marissa,
>
> Quick note from our ops and finance teams — during the scheduled maintenance window on 2026-09-29 we saw elevated tail latency and several streaming ingestion timeouts that impacted two of our downstream jobs...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Impact during 9/29 scheduled maintenance — rebate request

Jonas — I support a concession here to preserve the relationship and avoid a formal dispute with procurement. Counterparty is strategic and mid-enterprise; quick resolution is important. Approve the credit as follows:

- Consumption rebate: 10% of the October invoice (cap $25,000)
- One month service credit applied as an invoice-level credit (to be shown as "Goodwill credit")
- Condition: Veridian signs off on receipt of the RCA and mitigation plan within 10 business days; if we miss the RCA timeline, we escalate pricing remediation to the ops lead.

Laura — can you create a draft credit note (PDF) and route to finance for approval? Marissa — please prepare the short summary note for Elena that documents the credit terms and next steps.

Karthik
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@veridian.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T17:40:00Z
Subject: Resolution: consumption rebate and credit note for Veridian Health

Elena — thanks for the call earlier. We appreciate the detail you provided and we want to resolve this quickly for your finance team. Per internal approval, Redwood will apply the following: 

1) Consumption rebate: 10% credit applied to Veridian's October invoice, capped at $25,000.
2) One month service credit (applied as a separate line item / invoice credit) as a goodwill concession.

Conditions and next steps:
- We will produce a concise RCA and mitigation plan and share it by 2026-10-15 (Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/r/rca/veridian-maint-2026-10).
- Laura's team will issue a draft credit note (attached) and finance will apply the credit to your account on the next billing cycle.
- Please confirm receipt of the attached usage summary and the credit note draft; if you need formal PO/backing paperwork for accounting, we can arrange a short attestation letter.

Attachments: veridian_usage_oct.csv (customer-supplied), draft_credit_note_veridian.pdf (company draft)

We value Veridian as a partner; please let me know if the arrangement above works for your accounting team and I'll get the paperwork finalized.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
